      "reason_tag": "cleanup",

    {
      "name": "indexes",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Directly modifies TxIndex::FindTx in src/index/txindex.cpp to throw an exception on disk read failures or corruption instead of returning null.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.55,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Silently returning not-found on index corruption or I/O failure masks data integrity issues in txindex. As commit fa5c96a112 notes, 'a -txindex corruption may also point to a larger system corruption and it seems better to notify the user properly by throwing an exception.'"
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Has the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies getrawtransaction error handling in src/rpc/rawtransaction.cpp to distinguish I/O errors and pruned blocks from missing transactions.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.6,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Prevents RPC and REST endpoints from falsely returning 'transaction not found' when confirmed transactions cannot be read due to disk I/O errors or index corruption. Reviewer ryanofsky emphasizes that 'a confirmed transaction reported as missing is the wrong answer, and each path that turned an I/O or index error into \"not found\" now throws instead.'"
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "The edit to test_runner.py merely registers a new functional test for the RPC and index changes.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Tests pinning behavior of specific functional areas belong to those areas rather than test infrastructure."
    }

categories.name: indexes
categories.evidence: Directly modifies TxIndex::FindTx in src/index/txindex.cpp to throw an exception on disk read failures or corruption instead of returning null.
categories.rationale: Silently returning not-found on index corruption or I/O failure masks data integrity issues in txindex. As commit fa5c96a112 notes, 'a -txindex corruption may also point to a larger system corruption and it seems better to notify the user properly by throwing an exception.'

categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Has the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies getrawtransaction error handling in src/rpc/rawtransaction.cpp to distinguish I/O errors and pruned blocks from missing transactions.
categories.rationale: Prevents RPC and REST endpoints from falsely returning 'transaction not found' when confirmed transactions cannot be read due to disk I/O errors or index corruption. Reviewer ryanofsky emphasizes that 'a confirmed transaction reported as missing is the wrong answer, and each path that turned an I/O or index error into "not found" now throws instead.'
